blocks.text: Leading architects, engineers, contractors, developers, and construction professionals are set to gather at the Buildrite S.T.R.O.N.G. (Strengthening the Roots of the New Generation) Builders Summit 2026 on October 9, 2026, at Lanson Place, Mall of Asia, Manila, for a focused exchange on construction chemicals, materials, technologies, standards, and methodologies. With the theme “Building Beyond the Ordinary: Smart Materials, Sustainable Solutions, and the Future of Construction,” the summit features a carefully curated program focused on construction chemicals, material solutions, and engineering applications, offering industry stakeholders relevant insights into technologies and innovations shaping the future of the built environment.
